meta.title: Withdraw is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids rather than creating or searching for another event.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert Withdraw is present and clickable in the live RFQ stage Settings menu.
Select Withdraw to verify that it opens the withdrawal window without confirming the action.
Assert the withdrawal dialog opened and is awaiting a remark/confirmation.
Cancel the withdrawal so the live event remains unchanged.
Recheck that Withdraw remains offered and enabled after cancellation.
